Intro.title: Big Data Intelligence & Remote Sensing Image Processing Group

paragraphs.p1: Led by {name} ({career}) at the School of Computer Science and Technology, Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications, our group works on big data intelligence and intelligent remote sensing image processing. Research results have been published in journals such as IEEE TGRS, Information Fusion and Remote Sensing, supported by national and provincial funds as well as industry collaborations.
paragraphs.p2: We follow an integrated research-plus-engineering training model: members are encouraged to pursue high-quality papers, patents and competition awards, while also getting hands-on with real big-data platforms and algorithm projects — so everyone graduates with a solid portfolio and transferable skills.

highlights: Research training in remote sensing image processing and big data intelligence
End-to-end output of journal papers, patents and competitions
Engineering practice from data platform to algorithm deployment
